correctness.rationale: The proof gives an exact local characterization of same-color classes in a crown graph. A legal class has at most three edges; size three is exactly a directed \(3\)-cycle. This yields the lower bound. Classical Mendelsohn packing results attain it for every \(n\ge4\) except \(n=6\), while \(n=6\) cannot attain ten colors because that would be a nonexistent \(\mathrm{MTS}(6)\); an explicit eleven-color partition is supplied. The standalone verifier checks 38,918 candidate local classes, explicit constructions for \(n=4\) through \(8\), and exact nonexistence of a directed-triangle decomposition for \(n=6\).
